content.value: The following events occurred in “Messrs. ME Enterprise” in November 2023:
November, 01Started business with BDT 500,000 cash and equipment worth BDT 300,000.
November, 10BDT 7,000 was stolen from the cash box.
November, 15Cash withdrawal of BDT 10,000 by owner for personal use.
November, 20ME Enterprise took a loan of BDT 100,000 from Janata Bank,
November, 30Paid utility bill for the month of November BDT 2,500

(i) Show the journal entries of the above transactions of November 2023. 14   
(ii) Prepare a tabular analysis of the November transactions. 14

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
